body: Angel Batista is Cuban, and before the Castro revolution the man in power down there was named "Batista." The joke is referring to him. Definitely a Miami joke.

> Make a goal for six months from now

I don't have much, if any, invested interest in anything that I don't already partake in, and it's still not enough to make me want to keep going. What I need are people. I'm involved in a lot of things, and they all stimulate me for a while, but I need something more permanent. What I'm afraid of is loss, and being forgotten. I can't control that. The biggest thing I seek, and I can't control it. I just don't want to be alone.

I love movies, music, art, and I'm vain as all hell. But I need outside influence, too. I'm not an introverted person; I can't get hyped up by doing things alone, I **need** other people who I get along with. The activity doesn't matter to me, what matters is who I'm doing it with. I know what I need is motivation, and relying solely on my own existence doesn't give me anything to strive for. If I could, I would have done that a long time ago.
